changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: the AMP page reworked. Always on while installed.
AMP HLD runs from no hold (0) to AUTO (127), never cuts the attack and reads in steps; FUNC + turn jumps 0, one step at 120 BPM, AUTO.
ATK, DEC and REL (AMP and FILTER) step 0.2 ms up to 5 ms and show times; OVR gets a fine low end.
ENV RESET gains AMP and AMP+FILT: every sequenced trig and retrig starts from silence, without a click.
Saved projects play their HLD, ATK, DEC, REL and OVR on the new curves. Not for use with Env Reset Amp.
